verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a hosted compliance-automation SaaS. Whether its source is readable under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The pack shows no open-source release or license for the platform itself. The only GitHub evidence is a separate add-on repo of compliance 'skills' (goSprinto/compliance-skills) with no stated license, so it does not count as the product's source being open.
